note: PROBE + MEASURE SHAPE, byte-faithful body. The same self-scoped read for an account whose one api token is set never to expire: `expiring` is false, and `expires` is JUNK -- authentik leaves a stale, here already-past, value in the field rather than nulling it. A reader that trusted `expires` regardless of `expiring` would report this live credential as long expired; the correct reading is that there is no countdown to run. Identifiers and pks are synthetic.
